segments.headline: 85% AUTOMATION ≠ 85% SAVINGS
segments.body: Count the work that still needs people.
segments.spoken: A vendor promises eighty-five percent invoice automation. Does that mean eighty-five percent savings? No. Price the exceptions.

segments.headline: START WITH THE BASELINE
segments.spoken: Example: one thousand invoices. Manual processing costs one dollar twenty each. Monthly baseline: twelve hundred dollars.

segments.headline: AI HAS THREE COST LINES
segments.spoken: AI software costs four hundred dollars. One hundred fifty exceptions need review at three dollars each: four hundred fifty dollars.

segments.headline: EXCEPTIONS CHANGE THE MATH
segments.body: Review and correction are different costs.
segments.spoken: Twenty post-acceptance errors cost ten dollars each to fix: two hundred dollars. Total AI workflow cost: one thousand fifty dollars.

segments.headline: NET SAVINGS: $150 / MONTH
segments.body: Illustrative. Before setup and transition costs.
segments.spoken: The difference is one hundred fifty dollars per month before setup. Quality still needs independent testing.

segments.headline: TRACK WHAT THE DEMO HIDES
segments.spoken: Measure accepted results, exception rate, rework and customer impact. PrismBay AI helps operators build practical AI business systems.
